page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; below them a single full-page engraving (a plate, printed sideways to the text) filling almost the whole page. No running text or notes. At the far right edge, the neighbouring page's text is cut off and not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries an engraving, not a text block. It shows a row of Roman soldiers in armour, each holding a standard or pole topped with ornate finials and a bird or animal figure, standing in front of a building with a colonnade and a tiered structure. In the lower left, several figures in tunics stand near a table or stand with a cup. A small caption-like label near the building (lower left of the plate) is too small and faint to read; it is marked [illegible] above. The plate is printed rotated 90 degrees relative to the page. The text at the far right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
